The *Dosa Sutta* (*Dosasutta*, Iti 2) is the second discourse of the *Itivuttaka* in the Khuddaka Nikāya. Like its companion discourses in the opening section of the collection, the sutta delivers a succinct teaching on overcoming defilements, specifically declaring that abandoning aversion or hatred (*dosa*) provides a guarantee of non-return (*anāgāmitā*).
